turns.replyTail:
ere anything else a beginner needs to get started?

Besides the rug itself, the main item to consider is a non-slip rug pad. We recommend placing a thin open-weave or felt-plus-rubber pad under braided rugs when used on hardwood, vinyl, tile, or laminate floors to prevent slipping and protect your flooring.
If you choose a rug from our Non-Slip Collection, it comes with a built-in anti-skid backing, so no extra pad is needed.
